PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHANGES

KEY FACTS:
- In June 2023, the Office of the Chief Information Officer filled the Chief Data Officer (CDO) position.
- In May 2024, NASA formalized and appointed the Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO).
- The CDO is drafting the fiscal year (FY) 2025 – FY 2027 NASA Data Strategy.
- The CAIO co-sponsored a "Summer of AI" campaign that reached more than 4,000 unique participants across 40 events over the span of three months.
